framework_name: Capability, memory, skill, method, and meta-cognitive evolution distinction

rating_policy.supported by evidence: The pinned primary artifact directly demonstrates or reports this dimension in its stated scope. A paper-reported result is not independently reproduced by Task186.
rating_policy.partial: A related mechanism or bounded result is present, but the full dimension or transfer claim is not demonstrated.
rating_policy.not shown: The reviewed frozen artifacts and inspected scope provide no evidence for the dimension.
rating_policy.not applicable: The source is a benchmark or tool that is not itself an agent/inheritance mechanism for this dimension.

dimensions.capability_progress: A measurable change in task success for a declared task family and setup. Static permission profiles, memory persistence, and benchmark scores without a before/after comparison do not prove progress.
dimensions.memory_inheritance: An experience or memory artifact persists and is retrieved later in a way that conditions behavior; this is not by itself method inheritance.
dimensions.skill_inheritance: A reusable executable or procedural skill is invoked or composed in later tasks; task-domain transfer must be named explicitly.
dimensions.method_inheritance: A later run or successor uses a transferred procedure for selecting, creating, validating, and revising improvements, with transfer measured separately from facts, prompts, skills, and base-model capability.
dimensions.meta_cognitive_evolution: The procedure that monitors capability, selects improvement actions, evaluates candidates, or retires methods itself changes based on evidence under an evaluator it cannot write.

systems.evidence_summary: metarsi-primary-source-report.md; primary paper reports benchmark-bound improvement and specifies a scheduler/operator revision architecture; no cross-model inheritance demonstrated.
metarsi-paper-repo-crosscheck.md; versionable Genomes and a user-confirmed history-to-harness authoring workflow; no benchmark, training, or evaluator loop.
reflection-family-report.md; paper-reported improvement across task trials from stored verbal reflections, without a revised method artifact.
reflection-family-report.md; paper-reported output quality gains within finite same-model feedback/refinement, without cross-task persistent method.
skill-inheritance-report.md; paper-reported novel-task skill reuse in a new Minecraft world, while curriculum/critic procedure remains fixed.
dspy-harness-report.md; optimizer compiles prompt/demo programs against caller metric/validation data; optimizer method is not itself evolved.
persistent-memory-report.md; persistent memory stream and reflection inform later behavior inside simulation, not a transferable capability or method.
persistent-memory-report.md; paper reports long-context QA/retrieval outcomes and self-directed context edits, but no method revision.
persistent-memory-report.md; pinned code implements persistent versioned memory and user/reminder material, without an evaluation of capability transfer.
independent-evaluation-report.md; paper reports benchmark performance with an agent-computer interface; researchers, not the deployed agent, tuned configuration.
independent-evaluation-report.md; benchmark/framework measures agents and is not itself an inheritance or improvement system.
pointfire-external-crosswalk.md; operational memory, profile-scoped Packs, routing, and reversible runs are present, but no capability/method transfer claim is established.

global_scope_ceiling: No rating establishes general intelligence, consciousness, epistemic acceptance, or cross-model cognitive-method inheritance. In particular, persistence of memory, reuse of skills, task performance, or same-model reflection must not be relabeled as inheritance of the improvement method.
